title: Make known-finding regressions test the actual generalized defect
description:
For durable known findings, make regression evidence evaluate the violated invariant
rather than merely select a registry row or prove baseline existence. Scope each
predicate to the known defect class and a justified affected population; do not invent
a universal mechanic census.
design:
2026-10-09 DESIGN (Claude Captain, main 6f57be85). Profile: rules-clause-complete (permanent evidence for source fidelity). AGENTS.md 'Permanent Test Evidence' governs: no test-per-finding rule, no corpus census, exact source-fidelity regressions may be consolidated only into evidence that preserves or strengthens the same claim (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md).
POPULATION (bounded, by query): finding-registry rows whose defect has been repaired on main, i.e. rows owned by beads that CLOSED WITH the repair (currently 19.2.1: opus:F-19, F-20, sol:CAP-008, fable:F1, F5, F7, sol:CAP-009; 19.2.2: indep:008, 009, 010/CAP-012, opus:F-15, F-17, F-30, sol:CAP-010, fable:F4; 19.3.4: sol:CAP-001, CAP-002, opus:F-09 (narrowed)) plus repaired rows of open owners (opus:F-25 half-damage-branches, opus:F-01 hazard-success-branches via PR #567). Rows repaired later by open domain beads (19.3.2, 19.4.x, ...) carry their own evidence in those PRs and are NOT this bead's work; re-run this mapping only for rows repaired before this bead's PR.
METHOD per row: (1) locate the permanent evidence (test file + test name) that protects the row's invariant; (2) DISCRIMINATION CHECK: show that the evidence would fail on the defective state, by running the evidence's predicate against the pre-repair committed artifact (git show <pre-repair-sha>:packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json into a temp dir, or temporarily reverting the importer change in a scratch copy) and recording the result; (3) classify: DISCRIMINATING (keep), WEAK (asserts existence/count/baseline only, or passes on the defective state) -> replace with a predicate over the defect class's justified population that fails on the defective state (strengthen; never weaken; source-fidelity exact regressions preserved or strictly strengthened), REDUNDANT (a stronger invariant elsewhere already discriminates the same claim; retire only per importer-fix-protocol consolidation rule, naming the replacing test), MISSING (add one generalized predicate). (4) Record a per-row disposition table in bd notes (row, evidence, check result, action). The table is development evidence, not a new committed ledger.
EXCLUSIONS: no committed per-finding test index or registry field linking tests (the registry makes no executable membership claim); no new tests for rows whose existing evidence discriminates; no changes to srdGeneratedPack.test.ts blocks unrelated to the population.
acceptance_criteria:
- Each supported known finding has regression evidence that distinguishes repaired from defective state.
- Sibling cases within the known defect class are covered where independently identifiable.
- Unevaluable/unresolvable findings remain unresolved and cannot pass through an empty result.
- Corpus-wide claims are used only when the exact bounded population is independently established.
- The finding registry remains audit-fact authority, not executable-universe authority.
